title: monkeypatchlist configuration
description: monkeypatchlist.config.json (spec §16). Every setting but `name` has a flag, and a flag overrides its key field by field. Paths are relative to this file's directory, except entry files and mapping directories, which are relative to the build directory.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file follows, for editors. monkeypatchlist ignores it.

name.description: The application name, shown in the report header and the terminal title. It is not identity. Defaults to the build directory's basename. It has no flag.

entries.description: The HTML entry documents (--entry <file>[@<url>]). Defaults to index.html in the build directory.

file.description: The document, relative to the build directory.

url.description: The document's absolute http: or https: URL. Defaults to the first mapping's URL.

mappings.description: The URL→path mappings (--map <urlPrefix>=<dir>). The longest matching prefix wins.

url.description: An absolute http: or https: URL prefix.

dir.description: The directory its URLs are files under, relative to the build directory.

sourceMaps.description: Directories of source maps kept outside the build directory (--source-maps <dir>).

surface.description: The surface that is reported, baselined and gated (--surface). Defaults to protected.

mode.description: The remote retrieval mode (--mode). Defaults to offline.

lockfile.description: The lockfile that finds introducing dependencies. --lockfile <path> sets `path`.

importer.description: The lockfile importer (workspace) of the scanned application, when the first-party source paths don't pick it.

baseline.description: The baseline file, or a full JSON scan report read as the baseline baseline update would write from its scan (--baseline). Defaults to monkeypatchlist.baseline.json when failOn is given and that file exists.

previous.description: A previous JSON scan report, for the reachability and install-context notes (--previous). It overrides a full report given as baseline as the source of the previous values, needs a baseline (without one it gives no notes and a warning), and must share the scan-config id. Only scan reads it.

failOn.description: The baseline states that fail the gate (--fail-on). removed and unconfirmed can't gate.

allowIncomplete.description: Downgrades exit code 3 to a warning, lets baseline init and baseline update write, and lets scan read an incomplete report as its baseline (--allow-incomplete). After a fired crash guard, baseline init still refuses and baseline update leaves the baseline unchanged.

allowDowngrade.description: Lets baseline init replace, and baseline update rewrite, a baseline written by a newer catalog or monkeypatchlist version (--allow-downgrade). Only the baseline commands read it.

json.description: A path to also write the JSON report to, or - to write it to stdout instead of the terminal report (--json).

out.description: The baseline file that baseline init writes and baseline update rewrites (--out). Defaults to monkeypatchlist.baseline.json.

report.description: The saved JSON report that monkeypatchlist explain reads (--report). Only explain reads it.

verbose.description: Lists existing findings in the terminal report (--verbose). Only scan reads it.

listIneffective.description: Lists the ineffective writes in the terminal report, instead of only counting them (--list-ineffective). Only scan reads it.

noColor.description: Never colors the terminal report (--no-color). Color is used only on a TTY, and never under NO_COLOR.
